answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil attacks by making idle identities bleed value. A new agent buys a 100 POA bond losing 2 POA per epoch unless work refreshes it; an unused bond slides down a value ridge. The bond is a trellis, holding only while work passes through it. Forging 50 fakes costs 5,000 POA, and the decay spiral drains 100 POA per epoch unless every fake keeps working. An honest agent pays once, refreshing it with one job per epoch.
